facts.text: The hotel can be reached directly through the airport's departures terminal.
facts.excerpt: whose halls can be accessed directly through the airport's departures terminal

facts.text: Rooms are soundproofed and have views of the airport's active runways and the surrounding mountains.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy soundproofed rooms with views of YVR’s active runways and the surrounding mountains.

facts.text: Some floors are designated 'Quiet Zone' floors, kept silent during the day so tired travelers can rest.
facts.excerpt: the 'Quiet Zone' floors: these floors are designated silent during the day to allow tired travelers to rest.

facts.text: Globe@YVR has a Carry on Cuisine program that lets travelers take meals such as smoked British Columbian salmon aboard their aircraft.
facts.excerpt: the Carry on Cuisine program, which lets travelers take meals like smoked British Columbian salmon aboard their aircraft
Sip specially priced drinks while enjoying elevated shareable bites in a relaxing, upscale setting overlooking the runway.

facts.text: Fairmont Gold rooms on the top floor come with in-room telescopes.
facts.excerpt: Our top-floor Fairmont Gold rooms feature business class-inspired comfort, elevated amenities, and breathtaking runway views—complete with in-room telescopes for up-close glimpses of the action.

facts.text: Fairmont Gold rooms include lounge access with complimentary breakfast and evening canapes, a private concierge, and YVR FasTrack access.
facts.excerpt: Includes 24-hour Fairmont Gold lounge access with complimentary breakfast and evening canapes, private concierge, and YVR FasTrack access.

facts.text: One Bedroom Suites are designed for families, with a separate living area with sofa bed and a large bedroom.
facts.excerpt: Ideal for families, these suites feature soundproofed windows, a separate living area with sofa bed, large bedroom, ensuite with soaker tub and separate shower

facts.text: The hotel has a full-service spa and a health club with a pool and hot tub, and wellness amenities can be delivered to the room.
facts.excerpt: Experience relaxation with our full-service spa, health club featuring a pool and hot tub, and wellness amenities available for room delivery.

facts.text: The in-house spa offers a pink grapefruit jet-lag recovery treatment.
facts.excerpt: a citrusy pink grapefruit jet-lag recovery treatment at the in-house spa

facts.text: Guests can borrow a BMW cruise bike to explore the city between layovers.
facts.excerpt: A BMW cruise bike to explore the city between layovers

facts.text: Parking at the hotel costs an additional fee.
facts.excerpt: Parking available for an additional fee

facts.text: Dining ranges from Pacific Northwest-inspired fare to craft cocktails with casual bites and traditional afternoon tea.
facts.excerpt: From creative and sustainable Pacific Northwest-inspired fare to craft cocktails with casual bites or even a luxe traditional afternoon tea
